brief_text: ten dominoes stand in a row; the first is tipped over and knocks down the rest, and every domino ends tilted at least 15 degrees from upright

usage.text:

verdict.what_happens: The first domino falls into the next, triggering a cascade through all ten. They settle into a low, overlapping row, all visibly tilted more than 15 degrees from upright.

usage.text:
The first domino tips to the right, and the fall propagates through the row. The side view shows the dominoes settling into a low, overlapping stack, while the plan view shows them remaining aligned. All ten appear tilted well beyond 15° from upright.
